candidates.title: Oslo Opera House
candidates.firstSentence: The Oslo Opera House (Norwegian: Operahuset) is the home of the Norwegian National Opera and Ballet, and the national opera house in Norway.

candidates.title: Munch Museum
candidates.firstSentence: Munch Museum (Norwegian: Munch-museet), marketed as MUNCH since 2020, is an art museum in Bjørvika, Oslo, Norway, dedicated to the life and works of the Norwegian artist Edvard Munch.

candidates.title: Akershus Fortress
candidates.firstSentence: Akershus Fortress (Norwegian: Akershus Festning, pronounced [ɑkəʂˈhʉːs ˈfɛ̂sːtnɪŋ]) or Akershus Castle (Norwegian: Akershus slott [ɑkəʂˈhʉːs ˈslɔtː]) is a medieval castle in the Norwegian capital Oslo that was built to protect and provide a royal residence for the city.

candidates.title: Royal Palace, Oslo
candidates.firstSentence: The Royal Palace (Norwegian: Slottet or Det kongelige slott) in Oslo was built in the first half of the 19th century as the Norwegian residence of the French-born Charles XIV John, who reigned as king of Norway and Sweden.

candidates.title: Bislett Stadium
candidates.firstSentence: Bislett Stadium (Norwegian: Bislett stadion) is a sports stadium in Oslo, Norway.

candidates.title: Oslo Cathedral
candidates.firstSentence: Oslo Cathedral (Norwegian: Oslo domkirke) — formerly Our Savior's Church (Norwegian: Vår Frelsers kirke) — is the main church for the Church of Norway Diocese of Oslo, as well as the parish church for downtown Oslo.

candidates.title: National Library of Norway
candidates.firstSentence: The National Library of Norway (Norwegian: Nasjonalbiblioteket) was established in 1989.

candidates.title: Oslo City Hall
candidates.firstSentence: Oslo City Hall (Norwegian: Oslo rådhus) is a municipal building in Oslo, the capital of Norway.

candidates.title: Oslo Stock Exchange
candidates.firstSentence: Oslo Stock Exchange (Norwegian: Oslo Børs) (OSE: OSLO) is a stock exchange within the Nordic countries and offers Norway's only regulated markets for securities trading today.

candidates.title: National Theatre (Oslo)
candidates.firstSentence: The National Theatre in Oslo (Norwegian: Nationaltheatret) is one of Norway's largest and most prominent venues for performance of dramatic arts.

candidates.title: Oslo Central Station
candidates.firstSentence: Oslo Central Station (Norwegian: Oslo sentralstasjon, abbreviated Oslo S) is the main railway station in Oslo, and the largest railway station within the entire Norwegian railway system.

candidates.title: National Museum of Norway
candidates.firstSentence: The National Museum (Norwegian: Nasjonalmuseet, officially the National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design) is a museum in Oslo, Norway which holds the Norwegian state's public collection of art, architecture, and design objects.
